description: Draft the whole docs sidebar: every tab, in order, as octri_get_docs_nav returns them. A tab is { label, slug, kind, url, hidden, icon, sections }; a folder is { title, items, subsections, ... }; a row is { type: endpoint|guide|page|link, ref, label, hidden, path }. Nav buttons are not touched. Readers see it after the docs nav is published.
